updates.title: Pre Production
updates.description:
Trance is currently in the pre production phase, organizing schedules for shoot days, creating shot lists and executing budget breakdowns. 

Currently seeking further sponsorship

synopsis: Trance pairs high-level big-mountain skiing with an experimental visual identity. Beyond steep terrain and technical lines, the film will capture the travel, friendships, and experiences of a season spent chasing snow and competing in IFSA qualifiers. The mission is to create a visually distinctive film that reflects both the intensity of freeride skiing and the culture surrounding it.
title: Trance
